# Look for polymorphic sites in cif genes
The part is not used for the paper. Because the filtering with q20 remove reads in cif genes that map multiple times and have a low mapping quality
```{r, eval=FALSE}

## Positions
 cifAB_data <- read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "wSuz_genes_BLAST_hits.txt"), sep="\t", header=TRUE)

## Load sample names without filter
#vcf_path <- file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "vcf_data", "all41.bamlist.freebayes.noclump.gvcf.gz")
vcf_path <- file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "vcf_data", "all41.bamlist.freebayes.noclump.filtq20.vcf.gz")
vcf <- vcfR::read.vcfR(vcf_path)

#gt <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "GT", as.numeric = FALSE)
#dp <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "DP", as.numeric = TRUE)
#gq <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "GQ", as.numeric = TRUE)
#gt[dp < 10 | gq < 30] <- NA
#vcf@gt[, -1] <- gt
#good <- dp >= 10 & gq >= 30
#site_fraction <- rowMeans(good, na.rm = TRUE)
#vcf <- vcf[site_fraction >= 0.5, ]

## Select Samples
samples <- c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-FR-Ren000", "Col-IT-Tre000", "Iso-FR-Par006", "D-sub", "CN-Kun_KM5", "Ko-Nam_NW2" , "IT_Tre_Om300", "US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1")
vcf9 <- vcf[, c("FORMAT", samples)]
colnames(vcf9@gt)

## Get reference and alternative alleles
fix <- getFIX(vcf9)
## Dataframe with positions, reference and alternative alleles
vcf_pos <- data.frame(
  row = seq_len(nrow(fix)),
  contig = fix[, "CHROM"],
  pos = as.numeric(fix[, "POS"]),
  ref = fix[, "REF"],
  alt = fix[, "ALT"]
)

## Extract polymorphic position in cifA or B
cifAB_sites <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(cifAB_data)), function(i) {
    
    region <- cifAB_data[i, ]
    vcf_pos[
      vcf_pos$contig == region$contig ,
    ]
    vcf_pos[
      vcf_pos$contig == region$contig &
      vcf_pos$pos >= region$start &
      vcf_pos$pos <= region$end,
    ]
  })
)

## Get name of the gene
cifAB_sites$gene <- sapply(
  cifAB_sites$row,
  function(x) {
    cifAB_data$gene[
      which(
        vcf_pos$contig[x] == cifAB_data$contig &
        vcf_pos$pos[x] >= cifAB_data$start &
        vcf_pos$pos[x] <= cifAB_data$end
      )[1]
    ]
  }
)

## Get the start position of the polymorphic site
cifAB_sites$gene_start <- sapply(
  cifAB_sites$row,
  function(x) {
    cifAB_data$start[
      which(
        vcf_pos$contig[x] == cifAB_data$contig &
        vcf_pos$pos[x] >= cifAB_data$start &
        vcf_pos$pos[x] <= cifAB_data$end
      )[1]
    ]
  }
)

## Only one polymorphic SNP in position 1990 of Type II cifB
head(cifAB_sites)
nrow(cifAB_sites)
table(cifAB_sites$gene)

## Extract genotypes at the selected site
gt <- extract.gt(vcf9, element = "GT")
gt_cifAB <- gt[cifAB_sites$row, ]
gt_cifAB


```

## Check variants that are different between Bal/Trento vs Par6 and Renes
```{r}

samples <- c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-IT-Tre000", "Iso-FR-Par006", "Col-FR-Ren000")

freq <- wSuz.pooldata@refallele.readcount[, samples]/wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage[, samples]

freq_diff <- freq[
  apply(freq, 1, function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0.3),]

## Correlation of variants across samples
pairs(freq_diff)

## Variant that differ among strains
freq[rowSums(abs(freq - rowMeans(freq, na.rm = TRUE)) > 0.4) > 0, ]

## Variant that differ by more than 20% between strains are the one that are specific to the sample from Rennes
freq[abs(
  rowMeans(freq[, 1:2], na.rm = TRUE) -
  rowMeans(freq[, 3:4], na.rm = TRUE)
) > 0.2, ]


# Number of SNPs
sum(
  nchar(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info$RefAllele) == 1 &
  nchar(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info$AltAllele) == 1
)
wSuz.pooldata@snp.info[nchar(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info$RefAllele) == 1 &
  nchar(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info$AltAllele) == 1,]

# Number of indels (18)
sum(
  nchar(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info$RefAllele) != nchar(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info$AltAllele)
)

wSuz.pooldata@snp.info[nchar(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info$RefAllele) != nchar(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info$AltAllele),]


## Filter 18 variants which are not SNPs
wSuz.pooldata <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wSuz.pooldata,  snp.index = which(nchar(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info$RefAllele) == 1 &
  nchar(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info$AltAllele) == 1))

allele_freq <- wSuz.pooldata@refallele.readcount/wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage
```

# Check MAF across samples
As expected from the presence of a single Wolbachia genotype, the MAF boxplot on the called SNPs shows a reduced genetic diversity (@fig-wSuzmaf). Still, some polymorphism is found at some SNPs in Bal, Trento and Par6, but less in Ren000 and IT_Tre_Om300 (this may also be related to structural variation among these strains ?)
```{r, eval=FALSE}
#| echo: false

## Add positions

 # dplyr::mutate(gene = forcats::fct_relevel(gene, "wsp", after = 1))|>
```

# Plot tree
## Tree based on divergence 
```{r tree}
fstats <- poolfstat::compute.fstats(x=wSuz.pooldata, output.pairwise.div = TRUE, verbose = TRUE, computeF3 = FALSE, computeF4 = FALSE)

## Neighbor joining distance
tt <- ape::nj(as.dist(fstats@pairwise.div))
plot(tt)

bootstrap_nj <- function(x) {
  
  # Number of SNPs
  n <- x@nsnp
  
  # Resample SNPs WITH replacement
  idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = n, replace = TRUE)
  
  # Create bootstrap pooldata object
  x_boot <- new(
    "pooldata",
    refallele.readcount = x@refallele.readcount[idx, , drop = FALSE],
    readcoverage       = x@readcoverage[idx, , drop = FALSE],
    snp.info           = x@snp.info[idx, , drop = FALSE],
    poolsizes          = x@poolsizes,
    poolnames          = x@poolnames,
    npools              = x@npools,
    nsnp                = n
  )
  
  # Recalculate pairwise divergence
  fs_boot <- poolfstat::compute.fstats(
    x = x_boot,
    output.pairwise.div = TRUE,
    output.pairwise.fst = FALSE,
    computeF3 = FALSE,
    computeF4 = FALSE,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  # NJ tree
  ape::nj(as.dist(fs_boot@pairwise.div))
}


set.seed(123)

nboot <- 1000

boot_trees <- vector("list", nboot)

for (i in seq_len(nboot)) {
  
  if (i %% 100 == 0)
    message("Bootstrap ", i, "/", nboot)
  
  boot_trees[[i]] <- bootstrap_nj(wSuz.pooldata)
}

class(boot_trees) <- "multiPhylo"

boot_support <- ape::prop.clades(
  tt,
  boot_trees,
  rooted = FALSE
)

boot_support
## As percentage
boot_support <- 100 * boot_support / nboot

tt$node.label <- round(boot_support, 1)

## Reroot tree
tree_rooted <- ape::root(
  tt,
  outgroup = c("US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1"),
  resolve.root = TRUE
)

plot(
  tree_rooted,
  show.node.label = TRUE,
  cex = 0.7
)


library(ggtree)

##Remove word root from the tree
tree_rooted$node.label[tree_rooted$node.label == "Root"] <- NA

p <- ggtree(tree_rooted, layout = "rectangular", linewidth = 0.8)

## Round bootstrap support values to whole numbers 
p$data$Bootstrap <- round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p$data$label)))

## Group bootstrap support values into four support categories
p$data$Bootstrap_group <- cut(p$data$Bootstrap, breaks = c(70, 90, Inf), labels = c("70–89", "90–100"), include.lowest = TRUE)

##Make labels for strain names
p$data$display_label <- dplyr::recode(p$data$label, "Col-FR-Bal001" = "bolditalic(w)*bold('Suz Bal')", "Iso-FR-Par006" = "bolditalic(w)*bold('Suz Par6')", "Col-FR-Ren000" = "bolditalic(w)*bold('Suz Rennes')", "IT_Tre_Om300" = "italic(w)*'Suz IT-Tre (reference)'", "Col-IT-Tre000" = "bolditalic(w)*bold('Suz Trento')", "Ko-Nam_NW2" = "italic(w)*'Spc Ko-Nam'", "CN-Kun_KM5" = "italic(w)*'Spc CN-Kun'", "D-sub" = "italic(w)*'Spc D-sub'", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1" = "italic(w)*'Ri ZB'", "US-CA_wRI_Dsim2" = "italic(w)*'Ri US-CA'", .default = p$data$label)

## Select internal nodes with available bootstrap support values
node_data <- p$data |> dplyr::filter(!isTip, !is.na(Bootstrap_group))

##Make a plot
p_final <- p +
  geom_point(data = node_data, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = Bootstrap_group), inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 16, size = 3) +
  geom_tiplab(aes(label = display_label, fontface = ifelse(label %in% c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Iso-FR-Par006", "Col-FR-Ren000", "Col-IT-Tre000"), "bold", "plain")), parse = TRUE, size = 3.8, offset = max(p$data$x, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.012) +
  geom_treescale(x = 0.50, y = 0.25, width = 0.07, fontsize = 3.5, linesize = 0.8, offset = -0.45) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("70–89" = "#00BFC4", "90–100" = "#C77CFF"), breaks = c("70–89", "90–100")) +
  labs(colour = "Bootstrap values") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal", legend.box.spacing = grid::unit(0, "pt"), legend.margin = margin(t = -8, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0), plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 0, l = 5)) +
  xlim(0, max(p$data$x, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.18) +
  expand_limits(y = 0)

p_final

##Save the plot
ggsave(file.path(here::here(), "plots", "Fig.4C.pdf"), plot = p_final, width = 19, height = 10, units = "cm")

```


## PCA plot 
```{r pca}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 16 
#| fig-width: 24 
#| fig-cap: "Random allele PCA of Wolbachia SNPs on all the 8 samples."
#| fig-cap-location: bottom
#| label: fig-wRIpca

## Filter out bad SNPs
#wRI.pooldata.filtered <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wRI.pooldata,  snp.index = which(meanIso < 0.05))

wSuz.pca=randomallele.pca(wSuz.pooldata, plot.pcs = NULL)

## For the graph
pch.type =rep(16, wSuz.pooldata@npools)
pch.col  = rep(5, wSuz.pooldata@npools)
pch.col[which(grepl("sub",wSuz.pooldata@poolnames) | grepl("CN-Kun",wSuz.pooldata@poolnames))]=8
pch.col[which(grepl("sim",wSuz.pooldata@poolnames))]=7

scree_data <- data.frame(PC = factor(paste0("PC", 1:length(wSuz.pca$perc.var)),levels = paste0("PC", 1:length(wSuz.pca$perc.var))),Variance = wSuz.pca$perc.var)

# Plot the scree plot
tmp1 <- ggplot(scree_data, aes(x = PC, y = Variance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +  # Bar plot for explained variance
  geom_point(size = 2) +  # Add points to show individual PC values
  geom_line(group = 1, color = "black") +  # Line connecting the points
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Scree Plot", x = "Principal Component", y = "Percentage of Explained Variance") +
  ylim(0, max(wSuz.pca$perc.var))

data=as.data.frame(wSuz.pca$pop.loadings)
colnames(data)=paste0("PC",1:ncol(data))
data$sample=wSuz.pooldata@poolnames
data$strain=paste0("G",pch.col)
data$strain[pch.col==8]="wSpc" ; data$strain[pch.col==7]="wRI" ; data$strain[pch.col==5]="wSuz" 

# Plot using ggplot and ggrepel to avoid overlapping labels
tmp2<-ggplot(data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = sample, color=strain)) +
  geom_point(size=1) +  # Plot points for each sample
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE) +  # Add sample names without overlapping
  theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (",round(wSuz.pca$perc.var[1],2),"%)"), 
       y = paste0("PC2 (",round(wSuz.pca$perc.var[2],2),"%)"), title = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(5,7,8)) 

tmp3<-ggplot(data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC3, label = sample, color=strain)) +
  geom_point(size=1) +  # Plot points for each sample
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE) +  # Add sample names without overlapping
  theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (",round(wSuz.pca$perc.var[1],2),"%)"), 
       y = paste0("PC3 (",round(wSuz.pca$perc.var[3],2),"%)"), title = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(5,7,8)) 

tmp4<-ggplot(data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC4, label = sample,color=strain)) +
```

## Clustering of variants
```{r, eval=TRUE}


## Export divergence
fstats@pairwise.div

## Hirarchical clustering equivalent to UPGMA
tt <- hclust(as.dist(fstats@pairwise.div), method= "average")
plot(tt)



#quartz()
## Heatmap
heatmap(fstats@pairwise.div, distfun = as.dist)

## With ComplexHeatmap
div.hm <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(fstats@pairwise.div,
cluster_rows =TRUE,cluster_columns=TRUE,name="Divergence",
show_heatmap_legend=FALSE,column_title = "Divergence (1-Q2)")

div.hm
```
